name: 580W N-Type Bifacial Double-Glass Solar Module
tagline: Industrial-Grade 580W Bifacial Double-Glass Module for Commercial & Utility-Scale Projects. The CALLSUN CN580W combines premium N-type monocrystalline cells with 2.0+2mm dual-glass construction to deliver 580W output at 22.45% module efficiency. Engineered for commercial rooftops, industrial installations and utility-scale deployments with 144 half-cut cells, IP68 junction box and a 30-year linear power warranty (87.4% output at year 30).
tech: N-type bifacial monocrystalline silicon · 144 half-cut cells (6×12×2) · 16BB multi-busbar · 2.0+2mm dual-glass construction · IP68 junction box with 3 bypass diodes · Fire Class C
imageAlt: Callsun CN580W N-Type bifacial double-glass solar module front and back view on white background with junction box and MC4 connectors
description: The CALLSUN CN580W modules leverage premium N-type monocrystalline technology to deliver an impressive module efficiency of up to 22.45%. Engineering a massive 580W output, the CN580W bifacial double-glass modules combine superior low-light performance with robust industrial reliability to maximize your commercial project yield. Built for B2B distributors, EPC installers and utility-scale project developers who need scalable, IEC-certified module supply backed by 25-year product + 30-year linear power warranty.

specs.label: Output Commitment
specs.value: 87.4% output at year 30 (1% first-year + linear degradation thereafter)

benefits.title: Advanced N-Type Technology
benefits.description: N-type architecture ensures lower LID (Light Induced Degradation) and exceptional low-light performance for sustained energy harvest. Compared to traditional P-type cells, N-type modules deliver higher energy yield under dawn, dusk and overcast conditions—maximizing the commercial value of every installed watt.

benefits.title: Bifacial Power Boost
benefits.description: Double-sided power generation captures additional light from the back, significantly boosting your lifetime energy yield. With 80% ± 5% bifaciality factor, the CN580W harvests meaningful rear-side gain from ground reflection, snow and light-colored rooftops—translating directly into shorter project payback periods.

benefits.title: Multi-Busbar (MBB) Design
benefits.description: Multi-busbar technology effectively enhances product power output, reduces internal loss, and elevates overall module reliability. 16BB cell design shortens the current collection path, lowers series resistance and improves performance under partial shading—ideal for rooftop and ground-mount installations with mixed light conditions.

benefits.title: Minimized PID Degradation
benefits.description: Anti-PID technology ensures the decay rate is strictly minimized, safeguarding your investment against harsh environmental degradation. The CN580W is engineered to resist Potential Induced Degradation in high-humidity, high-temperature and high-voltage (1500V DC) deployments—protecting long-term yield in tropical, coastal and utility-scale environments.

benefits.title: Industrial-Grade Dual-Glass Build
benefits.description: Featuring 2.0mm+2.0mm tempered dual-glass with an anodized aluminum alloy frame and IP68 junction box for ultimate mechanical resistance. The dual-glass construction eliminates PID pathways, improves fire performance (Class C) and extends service life beyond 30 years—designed to withstand hail, snow, sand and salt mist without micro-crack propagation.

benefits.title: Industry-Leading Warranty
benefits.description: Backed by a premium 25-year product warranty and a 30-year linear power warranty, guaranteeing 87.4% performance at year 30. Combined with 1% first-year degradation and rigorous IEC 61215/61730 + ISO 9001/14001/45001 certification, the CN580W delivers bankable long-term returns for EPCs, IPPs and project finance partners.
